description: Conformance vectors for the cross-ecosystem action_ref v1 correlation key. Accept vectors carry the expected lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization of the four-field preimage; every expected value was generated by the SDK implementation (computeExternalActionRefV1). Reject vectors carry reject:true and must fail before any digest: either the timestamp grammar, or the profile's input domain (agent_id, action_type and scope ASCII only with every code point <= 0x7F; scope non-empty; no duplicate preimage key), per the Domain paragraph of giskard09/argentum-core docs/spec/action-ref.md at commit 6ceecf5442fb9a573fdc87a0559755437a7f379f. A reject vector carrying input_json instead of input states its preimage as raw JSON text, because a duplicate key cannot be expressed in a JSON object: verifiers feed that text through a duplicate-rejecting parser (parseExternalActionRefV1Preimage in Node, a strict object_pairs_hook in Python).

vectors.description: Basic happy path. Minimal tuple with a DID agent_id and a zero-millisecond timestamp written in full.
Second basic vector: did:web agent_id and a non-zero millisecond timestamp.

Unicode in action_type and scope (Cyrillic plus an emoji). Outside the profile's input domain: rejected with OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN before any digest. Changed acceptance behavior 2026-10-02 (was an accept vector expecting a99472d9b5ce07b8d977fc217452361df5b137af66d40bd03639bee4caa2b158).
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: action_type and scope carry non-ASCII code points; the profile's Domain admits only code points <= 0x7F in agent_id, action_type and scope, which is also what closes the NFC/NFD normalization ambiguity for this profile

vectors.description: Key-order independence. The same tuple presented in three different JSON key orders canonicalizes to one byte sequence and one hash (identical to av-001). Verifiers parse each variant and recompute.
Timestamp edge: last millisecond before midnight rollover, maximum fractional value .999.
Timestamp edge: first instant after midnight rollover, .000 milliseconds written in full (zero fractional digits are not omitted).

Empty-string scope. Outside the profile's input domain: rejected with OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN before any digest. Changed acceptance behavior 2026-10-02 (was an accept vector expecting cea68656343a06fad083af9a283329af96fcbc6c5fa183229823070fe635641b).
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: scope must be a non-empty string; the "" not-applicable exception was removed from the profile on 2026-08-15 to match draft-etcheverry-action-ref-02 section 6

vectors.description: Long scope string (588 characters). No length-dependent behavior in canonicalization or hashing.

vectors.reason: timestamp separator must be uppercase T; RFC 3339 lowercase t is not the canonical action_ref form
timestamp suffix must be uppercase Z; lowercase z is not the canonical action_ref form

vectors.description: Explicit +00:00 offset is invalid even though it denotes UTC.
vectors.reason: only the Z suffix is accepted; numeric offsets are rejected rather than normalized, one valid byte sequence per instant

vectors.description: Missing fractional seconds (second precision) is invalid.
vectors.reason: exactly three fractional digits are required; a second-precision timestamp is rejected rather than padded

vectors.description: Six fractional digits (microsecond precision) is invalid.
vectors.reason: exactly three fractional digits are required; extra precision is rejected rather than truncated

vectors.description: Non-ASCII agent_id (Cyrillic). Isolates the agent_id field of the ASCII domain rule.
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: agent_id carries non-ASCII code points; the profile admits only code points <= 0x7F in agent_id, action_type and scope

vectors.description: Non-ASCII action_type (an astral-plane emoji, a surrogate pair in UTF-16). Isolates the action_type field of the ASCII domain rule and covers the surrogate-pair case the Domain paragraph calls out.
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: action_type carries non-ASCII code points; the profile admits only code points <= 0x7F in agent_id, action_type and scope

vectors.description: Duplicate preimage key (agent_id twice). Stated as raw JSON text in input_json, since a duplicate key cannot be written in a JSON object: by the time such a document has been parsed into an object the second value has overwritten the first and the evidence is gone, so the rejection has to happen in the parser.
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: duplicate preimage key agent_id; the Domain paragraph requires stopping before any digest rather than silently hashing one of the two values

vectors.description: Duplicate preimage key written as an escape alias ("scope" and "\u0073cope"). The two member names are byte-different and decode to the same string, so a parser comparing raw name bytes accepts it and a parser comparing decoded names rejects it.
vectors.reason: OUT_OF_PROFILE_DOMAIN: duplicate preimage key scope; member names are compared after JSON string decoding, so "scope" and "\u0073cope" are the same key
